question: In a certain code language, 'RELATIVE' is written as 'GXKVCNGT' and 'PHYSICAL' is written as 'NCEKUAJR'.How will 'QUANTITY' be written in that language?
solution:
The position values of the letters, according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebab2cff0f3be69ddd79cba38ffe19ecac83a05532afd86296629c4d111d058b.png] 

The pattern followed here is;

RELATIVE is written as ‘GXKVCNGT’

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47ea16b07db194524b186e75e709280bcd15bf8a5ff0df8f573b23f6ba791422.png] 

PHYSICAL is written as **'NCEKUAJR'**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/836aeda90b4b78eb2ca7b736dc25d654f33ee747505347ba8a2924cf77c6b667.png] 

 

Similarly;

QUANTITY is written as **‘AVKVPCWS'**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8dfd939cd30e6796717060b0bda10bf041d68965c9f50faa3b50910c64496921.png] **

Hence, the correct answer is **"**AVKVPCWS".
